meta.name: Samuel Sulo
meta.description: Web developer and cloud engineer. Kitsune is the personal mark: a low-poly fox that signs the work.

copy.symbol_title: The fox that signs the work
copy.index_concept: The signature, the facets, the colorways, the voice of the brand
copy.lead: Kitsune is a signature, not a logo for a company: a small fox that marks a piece of work as built by Samuel Sulo, the way a signature marks a page.
copy.p1: A kitsune is the fox of Japanese folklore, clever and quiet. The mark keeps that spirit: a head reduced to seven flat facets, with no outline, that reads at 16 px in a navigation bar and on the front of a printed card alike.
copy.p2: The shape never changes, only the color does. On dark surfaces the facets glow in cyan and violet; on light surfaces the same tones deepen to keep their contrast.
values: built with care, down to the last facet
systems that run quietly in production
a quiet mark of authorship, never a banner
copy.quote:
A good system is one
nobody has to think about.
copy.mono_note: In one color the facets are told apart by opacity only: keep the mark above 12 mm in print so that the lighter facets do not disappear.
copy.palette_caption: Void and Neon cyan carry the brand on screen; Deep cyan takes over on light surfaces.
copy.type_sample_body: Websites and cloud infrastructure for small businesses, built to be fast, accessible and easy to hand over.
